cautions.quote: Truncate allows for less concurrency than DeleteAll, as the entire table will be locked until the transaction is committed.
Truncate with a filter should only be used when the majority of the table is being deleted, as otherwise DeleteAll will be more efficient.
Truncate is not supported when the OnBeforeDelete and/or OnAfterDelete event is subscribed.
Truncate is not supported when the field has Media and/or MediaSet fields.
